# fabric_sites (Data Source)

Decode FABRIC advertised resources into typed site data.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `excludes` (String) Comma-separated site codes to exclude.
- `force_refresh` (Boolean) Whether to bypass cached resource information.
- `includes` (String) Comma-separated site codes to include.
- `name` (String) Optional exact site name filter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Synthetic data source identifier.
- `sites` (Attributes List) Typed FABRIC site resource data. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sites))

<a id="nestedatt--sites"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sites`

Read-Only:

- `components` (Attributes List) Component availability data. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sites--components))
- `cores` (Attributes) CPU core capacity. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sites--cores))
- `disk` (Attributes) Disk capacity. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sites--disk))
- `hosts` (Attributes List) Host-level resource data for this site. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sites--hosts))
- `ipv4_management` (Boolean) Whether the site advertises IPv4 management support.
- `name` (String) Site name.
- `ptp` (Boolean) Whether the site advertises PTP support.
- `ram` (Attributes) RAM capacity. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sites--ram))

<a id="nestedatt--sites--components"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sites.components`

Read-Only:

- `allocated` (Number) Allocated component count.

- `capacity` (Number) Advertised component count.
- `name` (String) Component key.
